title: Tracecat 1.2.0-alpha.3
body_markdown:
## Case management


- perf(cases): Debounce searches and cancel superseded requests ([#3800](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3800) )


## Agents


- feat(agents): Filter agents by MCP server and workflow ([#3833](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3833) )
- fix(mcp): Prioritize integration actions in discovery ([#3834](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3834) )


## Integrations


- fix(integrations): Let the GitHub gist actions use a personal access token ([#3818](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3818) )
- fix(integrations): Try user tokens before the app token for gists ([#3836](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3836) )


## Engine


- fix(engine): Time out only the action call, not platform work ([#3794](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3794) )
- perf(engine): Prepare cold registry artifacts in parallel ([#3806](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3806) )
- feat(engine+ui): Rerun past runs with fixed action results ([#3829](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3829) )


## User interface


- feat(ui): Remove Beta tag from Chat in the sidebar ([#3842](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3842) )
- fix(ui): Resize cramped dialogs and stop missing-integration toast ([#3846](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3846) )


**Full changelog** :[1.2.0-alpha.2...1.2.0-alpha.3](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.2.0-alpha.2...1.2.0-alpha.3)
